summary: Murano Global Investments Plc filed a Form 6-K announcing a milestone in the restructuring of its $300M 11.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2031. The company terminated its hotel management agreement with Hyatt and entered a new arrangement with Ennismore to rebrand its Grand Island I hotel as Mondrian, converting 328 rooms into residential condominiums for sale. The restructuring aims to improve financial performance. No price/share, premium, or advisor named. Watch for completion of the full restructuring plan and its impact on noteholder recoveries.
